services.name: Single Kayak
services.desc: Buying a sea kayak is not just about what looks good online. It’s about choosing a boat that fits your skills now, where you paddle most, and where you want to grow as a paddler. We carry a full selection of Delta touring and sea kayaks for sale in Seattle, with a focus on practical 12-14 foot models that handle Lake Union confidently and stay composed on Puget Sound. For longer crossings and overnight trips, we also stock true sea kayaks designed for efficiency, storage, and open water performance. services.name: Paddleboard (SUP)
services.desc: NWOC offers kayak and paddleboard rentals on Lake Union in Seattle, launching directly from our docks on the west side of lake. Our team will help you choose the right kayak and get comfortable before heading out. Our rentals include quality equipment, friendly guidance and a relaxed 90-minute minimum so you have time to explore without feeling rushed. We have a limited number of single and double kayaks available to reserve online at no charge. The majority of our rentals are only reservable over the phone.
